messages:
Ravi S.: Received invoice AT-INV-784 from Innsbruck Analytics (EUR 6,750). They applied reverse-charge (0% VAT) but we can't find a valid DE/AT VAT match in VIES for the number on their PDF. Should we ask for proof of business VAT registration or treat as domestic?

Ana G.: Can you paste the VAT as it appears on the PDF? Austria uses ATU########. Sometimes suppliers send the number without the ATU prefix.

Ravi S.: It shows 43456789 on the PDF (no prefix). File attached in vendor thread.

Tom H.: That looks like they stripped the ATU. If we try ATU43456789 in VIES it returns valid but registered name differs slightly. Need supplier declaration for reverse-charge (B2B) + their VAT confirmation PDF.

Ana G.: Ask for one of: (1) a screenshot/printout from Austrian tax portal showing the VAT number, or (2) a signed supplier declaration confirming their VAT and that the supply is B2B within EU and reverse-charge applies. Also request reissued invoice with full VAT format (ATU...).

Ravi S.: OK I'll message vendor and put payment on hold. Drafting note: "Please reissue invoice with VAT in format 'ATU########' and provide VAT registry proof or signed declaration that the transaction is B2B within EU and reverse-charge applies. Payment held until receipt"

AP-bot: Payment hold placed on AT-INV-784  reason: VAT verification pending. AP queue notified.

Tom H.: FYI if vendor refuses to provide evidence we should assume VAT applies and ask them to reissue with Austrian VAT charged. We can't self-apply VAT without documentation.

Ana G.: Agreed. Also log this in QuickBooks vendor notes so accounting can track if they later claim late-payment penalties.

Ravi S.: Sent message to vendor at 2026-07-09T09:22:14Z. Closing for now, will reopen when vendor responds. :white_check_mark:
